text:
jamie: CI red on main — integration-tests failing at decrypt step. KMS AccessDenied. Anyone touched KMS bindings for repo:redwood/platform? Need a rerun and quick triage. https://github.com/redwood/platform/actions/runs/123456789
sasha: on it. can you paste the job link/log snippet?
jamie: log snippet: `ERROR KMS: AccessDeniedException: Caller does not have permission to decrypt`. full run: https://github.com/redwood/platform/actions/runs/123456789. this started right after the key rotation earlier today.
deploy-bot: workflow run started by push from @alex — integration-tests failed (decrypt step) — https://github.com/redwood/platform/actions/runs/123456789
morgan: i rotated the key this morning but planned to add the new iam binding afterwards, checking now.
alex: I triggered the rotation. i thought the infra script added the binding; looks like `github-actions[repo=redwood/platform]` wasn't bound to `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/runner-key`.
jamie: can someone reapply binding or rerun? blocking the release branch cut.
sasha: i can reapply. example command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding runner-key --member=serviceAccount:github-actions@github.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
morgan: also double-check vault -> gha uses short-lived creds; if KMS mapping mismatched the decrypt call will still fail.
alex: added the binding for the service account and kicked a rerun, pinging @ci-bot to run it.
ci-bot: manual rerun requested by sasha — attempt #1 started
ci-bot: rerun failed: still seeing decrypt errors. logs now show OIDC token audience mismatch: `aud` expected `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`, got `https://github.com/`
sasha: odd. maybe the runner image is minting id tokens with wrong audience. @morgan can you check runner config?
morgan: checking — runner's OIDC audience was set to `https://github.com/` (bad). i'll flip it to `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com` and redeploy the runners.
alex: while morgan redeploys, can someone try a rerun with env override for id token? if not, we should bisect which commit introduced the bad runner config, but i prefer fix+rerun.
jamie: bisect would be slow; hold the release until runners are fixed and we can confirm one successful run.
morgan: runners redeployed with corrected audience, probing the job now.
ci-bot: rerun started — attempt #2
ci-bot: integration-tests succeeded — :tada: all green.
jamie: thanks all — huge help. i'll open a short postmortem and add a preflight check for KMS bindings + runner OIDC audience in infra. assigning follow-up to @alex and @morgan.
sasha: noted; i'll add a tiny workflow that validates `kms:decrypt` permission before critical jobs :thumbsup:
